name: server-side-swift
description: Codex skills for adding, building, testing, and operating server-side Swift components in canonical product workspaces, with native Homebrew local services and GitHub-only Linux builds and deployments.

interface.shortDescription: Server-side Swift workspace components, native Homebrew local services, and GitHub-only Linux build and deployment guidance.
interface.longDescription: Guide Codex agents through Hummingbird and Vapor components under Services/ in one canonical Xcode workspace. Keep Swift builds and Homebrew-managed dependencies native on macOS, use Soto as the default Swift AWS SDK, and reserve Linux artifacts, OCI images, live-test deployments, and production deployments for GitHub Actions.
